definition.fit_data: all labels of the selected training cases; no validation/test labels
definition.scale: 90th percentile of abs(stress), or RMS if that percentile is zero; floor 1e-12
definition.spread: pooled population standard deviation of asinh(stress / scale); floor 1e-8

config.protocol: each pooled node exactly once per complete epoch, shuffled
config.checkpoint_selection: minimum worst-case all-original-node decoded stress relative L2
config.precision: native TCNN FP16 computation, FP32 master parameters, float32 returned output

implementation_details.precision: native TCNN FP16 computation, FP32 master parameters, float32 returned output

config.optimizer_continuation: fresh Adam; parent optimizer is deliberately not restored, matching slides
